name: Stolypin Repressions and Mass Displacement (1906–1914) (C0069)

techniques.comment: The economic squeezing of peasants onto the imperial frontier under the guise of free choice: "during 1906–12 about 1 million people left Ukraine for Asiatic Russia. The largest number of resettlers came from Left-Bank Ukraine, whose peasantry suffered from land scarcity"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012); land and credit were unobtainable at home, while "Low land prices beyond the Urals and encouraging government credits… attracted the poor peasantry and prompted it to migrate"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012) – state coercion was disguised as voluntary resettlement.

The forcible suppression of protests and repressive measures against national self-organization of the same period: Stolypin's "instruction to the governors… demanding a halt to the registration of 'alien,' including Ukrainian, national cultural-educational societies"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012).
